title: mutation-testing team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/mutation-testing.yaml, the team layer of the mutation-testing plugin's config, written by /mutation-testing:setup apply and read by /mutation-testing:audit. Every key is optional; a key no layer sets takes the audit's fallback. Keys and their meaning: the plugin's skills/setup/templates/config-template.md; layers and merge: skills/setup/SKILL.md "The config merge model". Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

tool.description: The mutation tool driving this project's test runner. manual means no off-the-shelf tool covers the language, and the audit applies each mutant by the single-operator manual protocol.

command.description: How to invoke the tool, written out rather than derived, since every project wraps its tooling differently.

diff-target.description: The git ref the diff is taken against, resolved from the repository's default branch (origin/HEAD) when setup writes it.

mutate.description: Source globs to mutate, excluding generated code, vendored directories and test code. Lists union across layers.

operators.description: Operator set. default is the tool's own defaults; narrow restricts to statement-block removal plus relational-operator replacement, for a cheaper run.

timeout-ms.description: Per-mutant timeout in milliseconds, derived from the measured baseline suite time.

baseline-suite-ms.description: Measured wall-clock of one unmutated suite run, in milliseconds, when setup last ran.

max-mutants.description: Cap on how many mutants one audit run generates. Absent: the audit's effort cap applies.

test-command.description: The project's test command for runs restricted to named test files, used by audit --exercised. {tests} must appear as a standalone, unquoted word; it is replaced with the test paths, one argument each.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example audit); an entry beats this file's verification value.
